summary: Phase 2 iteration 4 (7 curated presets + per-wallpaper intensity). Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed on the public EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Public GET /api/wallpapers returns >=10 wallpapers; the 4 featured demo wallpapers are correctly mapped Mahadev->himalayan, Krishna->river, Ganesh Ji->divineGlow, Temple->temple, each isLive=true with animationConfig.intensity=='medium'; non-live wallpapers all carry animationPreset=='none'. No old preset names (clouds/petals/particles/lightRays/snow/fire) remain in the DB. Admin login + POST /api/admin/uploads (1x1 PNG) returns 200 (NOT 503) and /api/files/{path} serves bytes back byte-identical, and a created live wallpaper with animationPreset='temple' + intensity='high' appears on the public feed with those exact fields. Regression pass: /api/categories, /api/daily-darshan (devanagari), search krishna, /api/admin/dashboard, publish/unpublish, and admin routes reject missing JWT with 401. Frontend: mobile viewport 390x844 loads cleanly with no console errors and no red screen. Home shows hero LIVE badge (badge-live 15 / badge-static 10), Jeevant Darshan · Live row is populated, and the Hindi Daily Darshan card renders. Live wallpaper -> detail-preview -> live-preview-screen renders the animated Temple scene without runtime exceptions. Apply sheet shows apply-dismiss and correctly HIDES apply-open-chooser on web (canApplyNative=false) — copy correctly says the DivyaLive Android build is needed. Profile -> Live Wallpaper Settings shows quality-high/quality-balanced/quality-saver plus toggle-animations and toggle-particles and persists across close/reopen. Admin Studio: admin-login works with seeded creds, toggle-live reveals ALL 7 preset chips (preset-peaceful/temple/himalayan/rain/river/divineGlow/night) AND all 3 intensity chips (intensity-low/medium/high). Creating a wallpaper with preset-himalayan + intensity-high via create-wallpaper (no upload) succeeded and was verified via GET /api/wallpapers (animationPreset='himalayan', animationConfig.intensity='high'); test wallpaper cleaned up.

issues: Known RN-Web deprecation warnings ('pointerEvents' and 'shadow*' props) — per handoff note, NOT to be treated as a bug. Cosmetic only.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py seed() now upserts the four featured demos idempotently — previous stale-Temple issue is resolved and cannot regress from prior test cycles.
LiveEffect.tsx cleanly encodes the 7 curated presets as compositions of L (particle layers) + overlays with a QUALITY_FACTOR * INTENSITY_FACTOR scale — correct multiplicative behavior.
AdminStudio.tsx conditionally renders preset AND intensity chips only when toggle-live is ON — matches Phase 2 UX contract.
Apply sheet on web correctly hides apply-open-chooser (canApplyNative false) and states DivyaLive Android build is needed — intentionally honest, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested testIDs and flows verified

seed_data_creation: One TEST_it4_ui_wallpaper (himalayan/high) was created via the admin UI, verified in the public feed, then deleted via DELETE /api/admin/wallpapers/{id}. Backend pytest also created and cleaned up TEST_it4_temple_* wallpapers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend base URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (https://deity-live-launch.preview.emergentagent.com). Admin creds in /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Delete admin uses DELETE /api/admin/wallpapers/{id} (not /api/wallpapers/{id}). Publish/unpublish uses PATCH /api/admin/wallpapers/{id}/publish?published=true|false (query param). Featured mapping: Mahadev->himalayan, Krishna->river, Ganesh Ji->divineGlow, Temple->temple (all intensity='medium'). Native Android live-wallpaper apply cannot run on Expo Go/web — expected.
rca_of_issue: No open bugs. All Phase 2 iteration 4 acceptance criteria pass end-to-end.
